title: sodium issue #3750: Certain Particle Resource Packs for Polytone are broken in combination with Sodium 0.8.12 on 1.21.1

text:
[issue by acanthii] ### Bug Description With Sodium 0.8.12 and Polytone installed (and a resource pack that adds Polytone particles like Vanilla Effects+?), particles are BAD. For whatever reason, picking up an item worsens this effect while the item pickup animation is on-screen. [Log of a clean install with 10 basic mods](https://mclo.gs/SiucByr) (i dont think it's relevant, but who knows.) Polytone is claiming this is a Sodium issue https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/polytone/issues/352
Images! [Collapsible]
### Reproduction Steps 1. Install Sodium and Polytone, and add a resource pack that includes custom particles. 2. Make a superflat world. (i think slimes might make the particles corrupt faster? this bug is very... hit or miss on when it actually occurs, but a superflat with slimes has seemingly consistently created this effect.) 3. Sob at the awful particles. ### Log File [latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29184151/latest.log) ### Crash Report [crash-2026-06-21_17.42.26-client.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29184167/crash-2026-06-21_17.42.26-client.txt) [comment by jellysquid3 (member)] This is probably caused by https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium/issues/3745, if they're using their own shader. [comment by Lolothepro (contributor)] > This is probably caused by [#3745](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium/issues/3745), if they're using their own shader. Isn't this a bug specific to 26.2? [comment by Redls07 (none)] Can you attach a resource pack for the test? [comment by acanthii (none)] https://files.catbox.moe/1wbei6.zip github wouldn't let me upload the file for whatever reason, uploaded to catbox instead [comment by douira (contributor)] Fixed by this PR to Polytone: https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/polytone/pull/358 [comment by douira (contributor)] The PR has been closed but the author of Polytone has implemented the identical fix. The next version of polytone will not longer have this issue when used with sodium.
